Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

A General Theoretical Paradigm to Understand Learning from Human Preferences (arXiv 2310.12036v1) · paper method: IPO is an identity-mapping special case of ΨPO that learns directly from preferences without a reward-modeling stage or the Bradley-Terry pairwise-to-pointwise assumption.

  • This assertion originated as an author proposal; separate review receipts determine its current status.
  • Version-specific paper report; no experiment or dataset record inspection was reproduced by this author.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

A General Theoretical Paradigm to Understand Learning from Human Preferences (arXiv 2310.12036v1) · evaluates on: The sampled-preference comparisons use three-action bandits, softmax parameterizations, 18,000 Adam steps and ten seeds; reported curves include means and 95% confidence intervals.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

A General Theoretical Paradigm to Understand Learning from Human Preferences (arXiv 2310.12036v1) · paper method: IPO optimizes an empirical squared loss on the policy/reference log-likelihood ratio of preferred versus dispreferred actions, targeting one-half the inverse regularization coefficient.
